name: TM09
description: Shoots 2 to 5 seeds in a row to strike the foe.

gifts.note: Just talk to him. This boy just south of the Pretty Petal Flower Shop on Route 104 gives you the Bullet Seed TM the first time you speak to him.

Beat the Rustboro Gym Leader (Badge 1). After the battle you get TM Package 1 (a set of TMs that go straight into your TM Case) and an Eviolite. If your Bag had no room for the Eviolite, talk to the Leader again.
